bandra.overview: Bandra is Mumbai's premier western-suburb address, split between the upscale Bandra West (sea-facing apartments, celebrity residences) and the more commercial Bandra East (BKC-adjacent office towers). It commands some of the highest per-sq.ft. prices in the city outside South Mumbai.
bandra.connectivity: Bandra railway station (Western Line) and the Bandra–Worli Sea Link give fast access to South Mumbai; the Bandra–Kurla Complex (BKC) business district is a 10-minute drive.
bandra.socialInfra: Schools: St. Andrew's High School, Apostolic Carmel. Hospitals: Lilavati Hospital. Retail: Linking Road, Hill Road.
bandra.techParks: Bandra–Kurla Complex (BKC) — Mumbai's second CBD, home to major banks, MNCs, and the NSE.
bandra.upcomingInfra: Mumbai Metro Line 2B and the Coastal Road project, both expected to further reduce commute times to South Mumbai.

priceTrend.comparisonNote: One of Mumbai's most expensive suburbs; price growth is steady rather than sharp, reflecting an already-mature market.

rentalYield.note: Strong absolute rents from a deep corporate-tenant pool near BKC, though yield percentage is modest given high capital values.

faq.q: Why is Bandra so expensive compared to other Mumbai suburbs?
faq.a: Bandra combines sea-facing inventory, direct access to BKC's corporate hub, mature social infrastructure, and the Bandra–Worli Sea Link's fast link to South Mumbai — a combination few other suburbs match, which sustains premium pricing.

faq.q: Is RERA registration mandatory for projects in Bandra?
faq.a: Yes, under MahaRERA, every new residential project in Maharashtra must be registered before sale, and the RERA ID must be quoted in all marketing material and agreements.

faq.q: What is the average price per sq.ft. in Bandra?
faq.a: Around ₹38,000 per sq.ft. as of this update, among the highest in Mumbai outside South Mumbai's prime addresses.

faq.q: What rental yield can I expect in Bandra?
faq.a: Roughly 2.5–3% annually — the absolute rent is high given BKC-adjacent corporate demand, but yield as a percentage of capital value is moderate because property prices are also very high.

faq.q: What legal documents should I check before buying resale property in Bandra?
faq.a: Title deed and chain of ownership, society share certificate and NOC (for co-op housing), encumbrance certificate, occupancy certificate, and confirmation of outstanding property tax or society dues.
